title: Final Answers for (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expressions for the reflected electric field components E_x' and E_y'.

title: Final Answers for (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expressions for the transmitted electric field components E_{1x}'' and E_{1y}''.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the boundary conditions for the electric field at the interfaces.

title: Reflection and Transmission Laws
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the laws of reflection and refraction for anisotropic materials.

title: Polarization State
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly analyze the polarization state of the reflected wave.

title: Mathematical Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for mathematical consistency in their equations and calculations.

title: Units and Dimensions
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all quantities have consistent units throughout their derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the boundary conditions.
